title: 후라이드 한 마리의 솔직함
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad with R&B influences. Clean electric guitar plays a rhythmic, syncopated chord progression with light chorus and reverb. A warm electric bass follows the kick drum pattern. Drums consist of a tight, dry snare and a soft kick drum. Male tenor vocals are centered in the mix with subtle doubling during the chorus. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the vocal melody and the guitar. Key of E Major. Tempo is 88 BPM.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar playing syncopated chords]

[Verse 1]
[male tenor vocals enter]
토요일 아침이에요
부엌에서 소리가 나요
내려갔어요 아버지가
아침을 하고 있어요

[Verse 2]
처음 보는 모습이에요
30년 동안 부엌에 서지 않던 사람이에요
어머니가 입원한 지 사흘째예요

[Chorus]
[bass and drums enter]
밥이 질어요 국이 짜요
반찬은 김치하고 계란말이하고 멸치볶음뿐이에요
